## Quality bar (docs/guides/quality-bar.md)

- [ ] Every state implemented with a screenshot (content, loading, empty, error, offline, no-location, signed-out, permissions as relevant)
- [ ] Motion tokens only; reduced motion honoured; haptics only where designed
- [ ] Performance budgets hold (or measured and noted)
- [ ] TalkBack in Arabic, 130% font, 44×44 targets
- [ ] Quran content: every verse from the data, never cut; tests pass
- [ ] Analytics: only events in the tracking plan
